comment: P8 sink-surface waivers — each row is an ACCUSATION that a shipped engine violates the clause it cites, recorded by gen_sink_surface.py's FIRST run (2026-08-12) so the matrix lands green over defects it found rather than defects it ignores. The ratchet is both-ways: a waived cell that starts passing is STALE and fails the run, so no row outlives its defect.  ⟨2026-08-12⟩ All 13 opening waivers deleted: the matrix reported them STALE on the same day it was built, because the defects it found were fixed the same day (candor-rust 97edc4f, candor-swift c5d657e, candor-java 58f06c8). An empty waiver list is the intended steady state — a waiver here accuses an engine of violating a cited clause, so it must be cheaper to fix than to keep.
